verdict.rationale: Ghostty is a local, native terminal emulator and embeddable library (libghostty) with no hosted service or cloud data storage, so choosing a storage region or data residency is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any cloud storage or sync that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
